title: Manager terminals 3: terminals mode in the manager tab
notes: Part of the parent card 'Manager terminals: ask the dashboard about any project and dispatch work into it'. The manager tab gets the same terminals layout as a project: a main Claude session and worker panes, working in ~/.dashboard so the session sees projects.yaml. Keys, help and which-key as for a project's terminals mode.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #155: manager terminals view, main-manager plus workers in ~/.dashboard, session socket reaches the manager slot (MANAGER_SLOT now -2). Manager workers not resumed after restart.
Merged in PR #155: manager tab terminals mode (main-manager session plus worker panes in ~/.dashboard), session socket reaches the manager slot. Version 2.34.0 after merging main.
